name: Clas Myrddin

attributes.attribute: Arthurian name meaning Merlin's palace or enclosure
island said to be the palace of Merlin

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Clas Myrddin, also called Merlin's palace or Merlin's enclosure, is an Arthurian name for the island of Britain. The whole island was said to be the palace of the magician Merlin, who served as its guardian.

okr.objective: Clas Myrddin names the whole island of Britain as the palace of Merlin.
key_results: Clas Myrddin means Merlin's palace or enclosure.
The island of Britain was seen as Merlin's palace.
Merlin served as guardian of the island.
